title: Coordinate decomposition
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, choose a coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. Then $f(x)$ is the sum of $x_i$ times the half-difference of the values of $f$ with coordinate $i$ set to $1$ and $-1$, and the average of those two values.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
$i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is a point of the sign cube
